بعد إتقان القراءة، يتعلّم الطفل أشهر الأ: After mastering reading, the child learns the best-known rules in a simplified way, with examples from the surahs he or she has memorized — which is what the poem
لام «ال» تُدغم إذا جاء بعدها حرف شمسي (م: The lam of «al» is assimilated when followed by a solar letter (as in ash-shams, "the sun"), and pronounced clearly when followed by a lunar letter (as in al-qamar, "the moon").
إذا جاء بعد النون الساكنة أو التنوين حرف: When a throat letter (ء هـ ع ح غ خ) follows a silent nun or tanwin, the nun is pronounced clearly without any extra nasalization (ghunna).
الغنّة في النون والميم المشدّدتين: Ghunna in doubled nun and mim
كل نون أو ميم مشدّدة نُغنّ فيها بمقدار ح: Every nun or mim with a shadda is nasalized for two counts; the ghunna is a sound that comes from the nasal cavity (the nose).
حروفها «قطب جد»؛ إذا سكن أحدها يُنطق بنب: Its letters are «qutb jad»; when one of them is silent it is pronounced with a clear bounce, and it is stronger when stopping.
مدّ بحرف المدّ بدون سبب من همز أو سكون،: Prolongation with a madd letter without a cause such as a hamza or a sukun; its length is two counts.
أعرف أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين بأمثلة: I know the rules of the silent nun and tanwin with examples
أعرف القلقلة وحروفها (قطب جد): I know qalqala and its letters (qutb jad)
أعرف الغنّة في النون والميم المشدّدتين: I know the ghunna in doubled nun and mim
